summary: Synced worker-1 with integration commit 4fcf3bba and reworked five documentation surfaces per R2/R3: vendor/PATCHES.md now classifies C01-C03 (plus C04's focus resolver) as gating/visibility and C04's range probe, C05's tracking field with move detection, and C06's trait-fill as ported fork-patch behavior with P-C/P-D and original-PATCHES.md provenance; observer.rs, registry.rs, and the demo comment describe the post-Batch-C state; docs/rewire-summary-b.md's gate table and carried rows are current.

tests.command: cargo test -p gpui-mcp --lib (21 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored)
cargo tree -p gpui-pre (resolves to vendor/gpui-pre at v0.3.6)
classification check: vendor/PATCHES.md carries the gating/visibility and ported fork-patch behavior classes with GPUI_MCP_REWIRE.md and vendor/gpui/PATCHES.md provenance

C01-VENDOR-GPUI-PRE.evidence: Unchanged by this rework: cargo tree -p gpui-pre resolves gpui-pre v0.3.6 to vendor/gpui-pre and the workspace-wide tree resolves no other crate from vendor/; cargo check --workspace exits 0 with no diagnostics.

C03-NODE-BOUNDS-EXPOSURE.evidence: observer.rs's module header now states that per-node bounds are published when the node's accessibility id resolves through Window::a11y_node_bounds, and that a node whose id does not resolve keeps UiNode::bounds empty; the observer tests assert bounds are Some for a live node and the parse test asserts the exact Rect mapping, with cargo test -p gpui-mcp --lib passing 21/21.

C05-POINTER-POSITION-PRESERVATION.evidence: input::tests::synthetic_hover_survives_bounds_changed passes, asserting the synthetic position survives a direct bounds_changed, a platform simulate_resize, and a simulate_scale_factor_change; vendor/PATCHES.md and docs/rewire-summary-b.md now describe the preserved-pointer behavior as ported fork behavior rather than a pending gap.

C06-TEXT-FALLBACK-STACK.evidence: vendor/PATCHES.md classifies C06's trait-fill as ported fork-patch behavior with P-D provenance; the patch (worker-2's 023e69e, merged under T07) is unchanged and type-checks under cargo check --workspace. Its unit test type-checks but cannot run in this fork because gpui-pre's test target fails on pristine svg_renderer.rs include_bytes! paths to absent Zed workspace assets.

C07-PATCHES-DOCUMENTATION.evidence: vendor/PATCHES.md's header now separates gating/visibility (C01-C03 and C04's a11y_focus_handle) from ported fork-patch behavior (C04's document-range probe in replace_input_text, C05's tracking field with move detection in bounds_changed, C06's trait-fill in resolve_font), cites GPUI_MCP_REWIRE.md P-C/P-D and the fork's original vendor/gpui/PATCHES.md as provenance, and keeps every per-patch table and code hunk intact; the classification check confirms all class names and provenance references are present.

risks: The Batch B coverage table in docs/rewire-summary-b.md is retained as a labeled snapshot (a note beneath it names the Batch C closures); its could-not cells still describe Batch B's state and its citations name stock 0.3.6 behavior.
gpui-pre's test target still fails to compile in this fork (pristine svg_renderer.rs include_bytes! paths to absent Zed workspace assets), so C06's shipped unit test remains compile-only here.
crates/gpui-mcp-html's runtime test hooks and visual parity bin still carry their pre-Batch-C referrals until T09 rewires them onto Window::a11y_focus_handle and Window::replace_input_text.
